description_excerpt: About The Role The General Accounting is a key contributor to DKSH's Finance function, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of accounting operations in line with Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS), tax regulations, and Group Finance guidelines. This role supports the Chief Accountant in driving sound financial controls, compliance, and continuous process improvement across the business unit.
